question: During the Second Five Year Plan, how many integrated steel plants were set up with foreign collaboration?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the **Second Five Year Plan**, **three integrated steel plants were set up with foreign collaboration.**
 
• The countries involved were the** Soviet Union, West Germany, and the United Kingdom** These steel plants were established in Bhilai, Durgapur, and Rourkela.
 
• The primary goal was to **boost the industrial development and steel production capacity of India.**
 
• These plants significantly contributed to the industrial infrastructure and self-reliance in steel production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Plan
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **First Five Year Plan**
 Focused on agriculture and aimed to increase food production.
 
 

 **Second Five Year Plan**
 Emphasized on heavy industries and infrastructure, leading to the establishment of major steel plants.
 
 

 **Third Five Year Plan**
 Intended to make India self-reliant and self-generating, focusing on agriculture and industry.
 
 

 **Later Plans**
 Subsequent plans continued to focus on a balanced development approach, addressing various sectors of the economy.
